answers.solution:
Done. There was no repository in the environment (only `/workspace/problem.json`), so I reconstructed the fix as a compilable, self-contained Go module and verified it.

**Artifacts**
- `/workspace/solution.md` — full write-up: root cause, exact fix, wiring, verification.
- `/workspace/solution/config/config.go` — the ordered resolver.
- `/workspace/solution/config/config_test.go` — 6 regression tests.
- `/workspace/solution/go.mod`

**Core diagnosis**
1. Env overrides had no single ordered resolution point, so env-only setups left the model empty and `llm.DefaultConfig` later leaked `gpt-4o` into the DeepSeek client → HTTP 400 → breaker → paused sessions.
2. The DeepSeek default must be gated on `DefaultModel == ""` (empty string), never a `"gpt-4o"` sentinel — that value isn't present in the resolver path since it lives only in `llm.DefaultConfig`.

**Fix**
- `applyEnvOverrides`: reads `CONSENSUS_LLM_MODEL` / `CONSENSUS_LLM_PROVIDER`, env > config file, runs first.
- `applyDeepSeekKeyDefaults`: only when `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is set, parses the **effective** base URL with `net/url` (scheme-tolerant, port-stripped) and `strings.EqualFold(u.Hostname(), "api.deepseek.com")`; then, and only if `DefaultModel` is empty, sets `deepseek-v4-flash`.

**Verification**
```
go vet ./...      # clean
go test ./... -v  # 6/6 PASS, ok dfconsensus14/config 0.002s
```
Covered: env model precedence, env provider precedence, env-only DeepSeek default, non-DeepSeek negative, explicit-env model survival, explicit-config model survival.

signatures.description: DF-CONSENSUS-14 (consensus, Go): env-only LLM setup sent model=gpt-4o to DeepSeek -> HTTP 400 x3 -> circuit breaker -> paused sessions. Working approach: put env overrides in the single applyEnvOverrides resolution point (CONSENSUS_LLM_MODEL/CONSENSUS_LLM_PROVIDER, env > config file); in the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY branch parse the EFFECTIVE base URL (net/url, EqualFold hostname api.deepseek.com) and only when no explicit model is set default the model to a provider-valid id (deepseek-v4-flash). Key subtlety: the compiled default config leaves DefaultModel empty (the gpt-4o default lives in llm.DefaultConfig, a different path), so gate the provider default on empty-string, never on a sentinel model name. 6 regression tests: 2 precedence, default, non-DeepSeek negative, explicit-env + explicit-config survival.
